name: Build a Glacier feature
goal: Use the approved card to make a Glacier change, prove it with independent checks, and merge only when every required check passes.

config.cmd: printf '%s' 'Card text is supplied by setup/selfbuild/run_card.py'

config.prompt: Review the loaded card. Approve starting this feature work in an isolated worktree?

Implement the feature described by this card. Follow the project rules and AGENTS.md exactly. Do not edit or weaken acceptance checks, invariants, or safety rules.

CARD:
{prev_output}

PROJECT RULES:
Follow AGENTS.md, NORTHSTAR.yaml, ORCHESTRATION.yaml, docs/contracts/VERIFICATION.md, and I-14. Do not modify protected verification rules. Do not push to GitHub. The acceptance checks and merge queue are controlled outside your worktree.

IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:
The full approved card is supplied below, including all acceptance requirements. Implement every behavior and test requested by it in the isolated practice worktree. You are authorized to edit the practice worktree files required for the card. Use the interpreter selected by the flow (GLACIER_PYTHON when set, otherwise the current interpreter); do not rely on a fixed machine-specific path. Run the card's acceptance commands and report their exact results. If a decision is needed or you cannot proceed, file a claim in vault/claims/ with the reason and evidence before stopping; do not silently park with a question.

config.template:
The feature worker failed. Its isolated branch was not accepted for merging. See run {run} and its event log.

{summary}

Feature worker completed for run {run}. Independent acceptance checks and any required owner sign-off determine whether the isolated branch enters the local main branch. GitHub pushing requires a separate approval.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: python -m pytest -q glacier/importers templates bench tools/scan tools/catalog

acceptance.question: Approve only if you reviewed the protected-path list above
